title: Volvo FM FUPS Hi-tensile Aluminium Bullbar #29
description: Volvo FM, FE heavy duty FUPS high tensile aluminium Bullbar. Custom built with heavy duty mesh and additional centre mounted small uprights for maximum cab protection. Custom driving light mounts can be fitted to customer specification. heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate. Provision for factory fitted radar. Removable aluminium Road Train /Long Vehicle signs are optional.
